$description: Binding of this design-repo to the N0 common design policy (Common Composition IR v0.5). Classification is decided from evidence in the clone source; every citation is resolved by extraction/verify_all.py (citation-validity). registry.manifest.json designPolicy points here and carries the contentHash of the files the policy is enforced by (checked by verify_all policy-binding).

classification.decision: B2B SaaS: tiered self-serve subscription plans with console sign-up, an Enterprise tier sold through a sales call, and Terms of Service that govern 'the SaaS platform'. The open-source / self-hosted Tares product does not change the category: the commercial offer (Rius) is a hosted, plan-priced service for businesses.

evidence.quote: Open source, self-hostable, and built on a production streaming core.

classification.classifiedBy: design-repo build agent (agent attestation, not a human sign-off)

generationRules: A PageSpec declares mode: clone | generation (schema-required, closed).

mode=generation must carry spec.brand (the operator's brand) and is rejected on any GlassFlow brand, person, customer, third-party mark, product screenshot, source asset, source URL/embed, source numeric claim or 5-word source-copy shingle (GENERATION_MODE_* rules, patterns in policies/source-identity.json).
Asset roles carry a closed availability (clone-only | generation-safe | blocked-for-generation) pinned in code in two places (PINNED_AVAILABILITY).
Tokens are referenced by name only and resolved against tokens/llm/token-catalog.json (TOKEN_* rules).
Templates, chrome families (mars vs legacy-black) and compatibility rules in compatibility/graph.json apply to both modes.

approval.note: Bound by the build agent from source evidence; no human architecture review has confirmed the binding.
